description_en: Queries the details of a DTS task by calling DescribeDtsJobDetail
description_zh: 调用DescribeDtsJobDetail查询一个DTS任务的详情
name: DescribeDtsJobDetail

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or change tracking task
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the data migration, data synchronization, or subscribe instance
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:
Forward: forward.
Reverse: reverse.

Default value: Forward.
The value Reverse takes effect only when the synchronization topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization
parameters.help_zh:
同步方向，取值：
Forward：正向。
Reverse：反向。

默认取值为Forward。
只有当数据同步实例的同步拓扑为双向同步时，本参数传入Reverse才会生效
parameters.name: synchronization_direction

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region in which the task resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return information about all synchronization subtasks. Default value: false, which returns only the synchronization subtask that is in progress or the most recently executed synchronization subtask
parameters.help_zh: 是否返回全部同步子任务的信息，默认为false，只返回正在进行中或者最近一次执行的同步子任务
parameters.name: sync_sub_job_history

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the task is a zero-ETL task. Valid values:
true: The task is a zero-ETL task.
false: The task is not a zero-ETL task
parameters.help_zh:
是否无感集成（Zero-ETL）任务，取值：
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: zero_etl_job
